sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Cell-surface immunostaining (non-permeabilized) confirmed surface display of the FLAG-tagged protein; no functional assay reported in the cited clip.
sites.rationale: L1 and L2 both report an N-terminal FLAG tag on full-length membrane-anchored NTNG2 confirmed at the cell surface. No residue is named, but the signal peptide (residues 1–17, landmarks) is the only upstream feature; the mature N-terminus begins at residue 18 (D). Python confirmed residue 17 = G and residue 18 = D, placing insert_after_residue = 17 as the unique topology-derived junction. NTNG2 is GPI-anchored with no TM or intracellular domain (topology string is all O from 18–530), so this N-terminal position is the sole extracellular terminus available for a surface tag. Full-length NTNG2 expressed in HeLa cells with an N-terminal FLAG tag; surface display confirmed by non-permeabilized cell-surface immunostaining (PMC6849109). No residue number is stated; the paper says only 'N-terminal'. NTNG2 has a signal peptide spanning residues 1–17 (landmarks), so the only extracellular N-terminus is the mature protein beginning at residue 18. The tag must sit after residue 17 (the last signal-peptide residue, G) and before residue 18 (D, the mature N-terminus); anything upstream would be co-translationally cleaved with the signal peptide.

sources.claim: (E) Netrin-G2 constructs were expressed in HeLa cells with an N-terminal flag tag.

literature_notes: L1 and L2 are from the same paper (PMC6849109) and describe the same experiment; L1 is used as the primary supporting clip. Both clips confirm surface display of N-terminal FLAG-tagged NTNG2 but name no specific residue, so position_evidence is topology_derived. NTNG2 is a GPI-anchored protein (topology: signal 1–17, extracellular 18–530, no TM); the C-terminus (GPI attachment signal) is processed and not available as a free extracellular terminus, leaving the mature N-terminus (after residue 17) as the only ledger-supported site. No internal loop insertions are supported by the ledger.
